name: SLICE SPLICE
desc: SLICE reads and SPLICE edits, with paired cases for shared span defaults, boundaries, relative paths, and option validation. Separate cases cover SLICE scalar/array configurations, explicit sources, strings and Unicode codepoints; SPLICE element-addressing versus array-addressing forms, the prohibition on bare NODE with integer options, replacement evaluation, and ownership. Complete span objects are supplied as ordinary data; no matching or capture construction is needed. SPLIT metadata, resource stress, and implementation-specific partial failure trees are excluded. Where strict is absent, lazy expectations also apply under full local validation.
